description: Kept the roll, and refused Verona in the Roman plot.

description: Set one play, and said the Rose bill was their afternoon.
name: John Heminges

description: Asked where his cue sits, and reported the bill he had read on a post.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Spoke in the passage after his death in the play, and stayed off.
name: William Shakespeare
